user_review.method: Maintainer public-entry review and explicitly simulated instruction walkthroughs; not fresh independent agents or human research. Deterministic executions marked separately. Prior body context disclosed for trigger predictions.

scenarios.request: Make one skill for long PDF to one-page decision brief; two available catalog skills cover extraction and rendering.
scenarios.expected: COMPOSE then continue the already-authorized entry-point authoring.
scenarios.observed: Before product example stopped for another build-it-anyway message. After complete illustrative catalog fixture says COMPOSE and continues authoring with a dependency handoff. No actual wrapper was requested or built in this review.

scenarios.request: No catalog is reachable, or user just asks to summarize a PDF.
scenarios.expected: Scope missing-catalog conclusion; ordinary usage bypasses creation check.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough states inspected scope and BUILD NEW only within it; ordinary summarization does not invoke reuse gate. User skip-check instruction remains effective.

similar_skills.learned: Search specific tasks and present useful install paths; inspect more than a result name.
similar_skills.reason: Keep functional comparison and scoped unknowns. Reject star/install-count cutoffs as quality proof and repeated permission after already-authorized creation.

similar_skills.learned: Pressure scenarios can reveal instruction failure; mechanical requirements deserve executable checks.
similar_skills.reason: Use bounded normal/boundary cases and actual code regression fixtures. Do not import mandatory agent delegation, exhaustive repetition or claims of universal loader semantics.
